config.expected_if_true: All 3 seeds: final accel_step margin >= 0.1 at its best layer, persistent accel_step formation in [60, 110], and that formation step earlier than the first checkpoint with val_mse_ratio < 1. At least 2 of 3 seeds: final force margin < 0.1.
config.hypothesis: The core N=64, e<=0.5 result does not depend on the particular simulated dataset. That result: a per-snapshot acceleration code beats best-of-5 controls, physical force does not, and accel_step forms persistently before the model beats constant-velocity extrapolation. Every finding so far used data_seed 0. With data_seed 1 and fresh seeds 75-77 (4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], lr 0.001, 600 steps), the same pattern appears. All formation steps are read from the per-checkpoint trajectory using unrounded margins and a strict >= bar: the first checkpoint after which the margin stays >= required_margin.
